translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga Davidi kuidi pfumu minyimbidi ; kayimbidila mu flute.

content.text: Nkua buvulu wuntubanga mu ntimꞌandi :
“kuisiko Nzambi.”
Bakibivisidi, zinzila ziawu zidi zimbimbi ;
kuisiko mutu wumvanganga mamboti.
Nzambi, wulembo tadi tona ku Diyilu bana ba batu
mu diambu di tala kani valenda ba batu balenda sudika ;
bobo bantomba Nzambi.
Batu boso bamana zimbala, bamana kibivisa va kimosi.
Kuisiko kadi wumosi wumvanganga mamboti,
kadi kuandi wumosi.
Bobo bamvanganga mambimbi, basudikanga ko e ?
Bawu balembo dia batu bama banga bu beti dila dipha ;
ayi batelanga Nzambi ko.
Kuna batitila mu diambu di tsisi
va buangu ki kondolo bila kimonina tsisi ;
Nzambi wukosikisa mimvesi mi batu bobo banuanisa ;
ngeyo wuba fuisa tsoni
bila Nzambi wuba lenza.
A, enati phulusu yi Iseli yitotukila ku Sioni !
Mu thangu Nzambi kela vutula kiuka ki batu bandi ;
bika Yakobi kamona khini ayi Iseli kayangalala.
